change_class: ADDITIVE — v2 inputs and figures (Prompt/pre-trade-check-contract-v2.md). No v1 key is removed, renamed or re-typed; a call with no v2 input carries every v1 key with its v1 value.
change_note: Optional inputs leverage / stopPct / targetPct / equityUsd / orderType add: `inputs` (the echo of what was checked), `calc` (the decision venue's figures from src/lib/pre-trade-calc.ts: volatility over the hold, round trip with spread, accuracy needed to break even, win rate needed for the stop and target, isolated liquidation distance, percent-of-equity figures), six per-venue keys (maker / entry fee, round trip, maintenance rate, liquidation distance, liq_basis) and three assumptions sentences. Liquidation comes ONLY from a venue's own published tier table (src/lib/venue-margin-tiers.ts), read only when leverage is sent; Binance's is signed USER_DATA, so its basis is tier_table_requires_key and it is never guessed. The tool computes and checks; it never proposes a size, leverage, stop or target.
source: src/tools/pre-trade-check.ts (runPreTradeCheck, toPreTradeCheckResponse) + src/lib/pre-trade-decision.ts + src/lib/pre-trade-calc.ts + src/lib/venue-margin-tiers.ts + src/lib/pre-trade-costs.ts + src/lib/venue-fees.ts; pre-deploy capture
calc_note: Every calc figure is null when an input it needs is absent — never a guessed 0. `win_rate_needed_pct` and `random_entry_target_first_pct` are break-even arithmetic on the caller's own stop and target, not a claim about any trade.
algovault_note: `exchange` and `venue_status` name the best venue and appear only when there is one; `upgrade_hint`, `tier_warning` and `quota` follow the caller's tier exactly as get_market_regime's envelope does.

error_contract.transport: MCP: every refusal is a structured JSON text payload with isError:true. x402 HTTP (POST /x402/pre_trade_check): the same payload with `status` as the HTTP status, unsettled.

invalid_parameter.note: v2 adds the params leverage (1-200), stopPct (0.01-50), targetPct (0.01-1000), equityUsd (> 0, <= 1e10) and orderType (market | limit)

quota wall (TierLimitReachedError).note: thrown and rendered by buildTierLimitPayload exactly as get_market_regime's wall — quota-surfaces row refusal:pre_trade_check

error_contract.order: invalid_parameter → venue_not_supported → quota wall → data_unavailable → coin_not_listed; nothing before the decision is billed

forbidden_keys_note: The contract forbids a `call`, `verdict`, `reasoning`, `price_at_signal` or any `outcome_*` key, a proposed side, and an edge / return / win-rate claim: this tool checks an order the caller already chose; it never reads or serves AlgoVault's directional call and never proposes a side. `descriptionRef` and `signal_hash` are internal identifiers.
consumers: MCP tools/list + tools/call (served; publicListing:false keeps it off the nav, /docs and /tools)
x402 HTTP POST /x402/pre_trade_check ($0.02, Bazaar-declared input schema)

cache_contract.description: Nothing in the response is cached per caller. The inputs are the shared venue-market-state caches (venue universes 60 s single-flight, the merged funding snapshot 30 s per adapter), the newest fresh servable bar-close regime generation and the newest fresh 1h generation for sigma (regime_snapshots, read-only), and — only when leverage is sent — each venue's maintenance tier table, cached 24 h per (venue, coin) single-flight.
cache_contract.client_cache_refresh: an open MCP session sees the new optional params after it re-fetches tools/list; a client that never does keeps calling with the v1 params, which still decide exactly as v1 did

drift_check_command: curl -fsS -X POST https://api.algovault.com/mcp -H 'content-type: application/json' -H 'accept: application/json, text/event-stream' -d '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"tools/list"}' | sed -n 's/^data: //p' | jq -e '.result.tools[] | select(.name == "pre_trade_check") | .inputSchema.properties | has("leverage") and has("stopPct") and has("orderType")' >/dev/null && echo SHAPE_OK
